_about: Riot Mode animations for the Riot versions of the Retro band (see source.json). Riot moves per musician; while Riot Mode is on the game rotates through every move that isn't marked "use": false, a new one every 2 bars. Same rules as the main recipe: 16 frames, start and end on the standing pose. Make with scripts/pixellab/animate.py assets/art/pixellab-retro-riot, pack with fetch_and_pack.py --source assets/art/pixellab-retro-riot/source.json.
